rules: One newest available general-purpose model with working text chat per family.
Rank suitable releases by confirmed developer release date/order, not by OpenRouter `created` field alone.
If several sizes released simultaneously, pick the main full-size version.
Do not hide a newer compact general-purpose model to prefer an older flagship; reflect the distinction, apply the 'newest' rule.
Exclude: embedding, reranker, image/audio-only, coding-only, and anonymous router models.
Multimodal general-purpose models are acceptable if text dialog works without required images.
Preview/beta status is acceptable if it is the newest available suitable release; mark the status explicitly.
No selection by our test outcomes, popularity, or price.
Author namespace on OpenRouter is established from the catalog and official sources, not assumed from the family name.
Pick one fixed provider endpoint per model; prefer direct official provider when available, otherwise justify a compatible third-party endpoint. No auto/free/latest/fallback routing.
If a family has no suitable available model, record the gap; do not substitute another family and do not declare the sample complete. ALLOW_INCOMPLETE_FAMILIES=false applies.
user_candidate_table: study/models/user_candidate_table.md — unverified input, must be confirmed or corrected against the live catalog
freeze: selection becomes frozen only after stage-04 pilot; catalog metadata is not a subject response
